description: Search the autario catalogue of public statistics (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, ECB, US Census, SEC) and your own connected datasets, and read a dataset's metadata and columns.

action.description: Which operation to run. search = keyword search over datasets; discover = datasets ranked for a topic by relevance, recency and source quality, needs topic; indicators = verified indicators that join across datasets; info = one dataset's source, coverage, freshness and change log, needs dataset_id; schema = one dataset's columns with their meaning, needs dataset_id.

category.description: Filter by category. Options: "Finance & Economics", "Trade", "Technology", "Health & Society", "Energy", "Environment", "Demographics", "Education", "Infrastructure"

dataset_id.description: info: The UUID of the dataset to retrieve metadata for schema: The UUID of the dataset to get the schema for

depth_pref.description: Preferred dataset shape. "timeseries" for trend articles (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly cadence), "cross-sectional" for snapshots (rankings, lists), "any" for no preference.

entity_type.description: Filter by entity_type: country | subnational | aggregate | company | security

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

frequency.description: Filter by frequency: year | quarter | month | week | day

limit.description: search: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100) discover: Max datasets to return (1-50, default 10). indicators: Max results (default 50, max 500)

publisher.description: Filter by publisher (World Bank, Eurostat, FRED, WHO, …)

query.description: Search term to match against dataset titles, descriptions, and keywords (e.g. "GDP growth", "CO2 emissions", "unemployment rate")

recency_window.description: Filter by data freshness. Default "any" returns all datasets regardless of last_refreshed_at; tighter windows for time-sensitive articles.

search.description: Full-text search across indicator titles + descriptions

topic.description: discover: The topic to find datasets for. Free-form, matches against asset topic field, title, keywords, category, and enriched description. Examples: "AI investment", "EU energy transition", "global inflation", "tech platform shifts" indicators: Filter by topic: economy | finance | trade | marketing | health | demographics | education | energy | environment | food | technology | media | housing | transport | tourism | space | government | military | minerals

unit.description: Filter by unit: USD | EUR | % | per capita | per 1000 | years | tonnes | tonnes CO2 | GWh | TWh | index | count | …

visibility.description: Which datasets to search: "public" catalog only, "private" only your own datasets, "both". Default: "both" when authenticated, "public" otherwise. Other users' private datasets are never returned.

name: find_data
